{{Top|leg}}
'''Sales''' was one of the six main departments of [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. The head of Sales was a member of the [[Executives]]. Sales handled all [[Ore/Legends|ore]] and refined material transactions to companies such as [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], and [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]].
